en: Old color-printed postcard with two architectural views of a historic town hall complex. The left vignette, titled "Eingang zum Rathaus.", shows people walking through an arched gateway leading into a courtyard surrounded by buildings with red-tiled roofs. The right vignette, titled "Rathausshof", depicts the inner courtyard of the same town hall, with ivy-covered walls, wooden balconies, and a tall corner tower. At upper right is printed the greeting "Gruss aus Hermannstadt." in red. The front is densely covered with handwritten script in German. The reverse side is a divided postcard back printed with the Hungarian word "LEVELEZŐ-LAP.", address lines filled in cursive, a postal cancellation, and Hungarian stamps.
